correctness.rationale: For every finite rooted forest the explicit stick-breaking map is an interior bijection. The triangular determinant equals the product of survival powers indexed by descendant subtree sizes, giving independent normalized beta variables. The mixed beta integral establishes all multiindices. For two vertices, exact expectation-product ratios use shared ancestor factors greater than one; when comparable, a special factor less than one and a sharp telescoping bound make the ratio strictly less than one. Distinct tree components use disjoint beta variables. Exact rational canonical-simplex integration independently passed 873 rooted forests, 59,602 simplices, 34,406 moment comparisons and 24,328 sign comparisons; these are corroborative finite checks rather than the infinite argument.

Known Stanley transfer and hook-length volume formula are expressly background; no inspected statement covers both the all-degree uniform-volume factorization and ancestor/incomparable/component covariance trichotomy. The previously recorded complete multipartite stable-set formula has genuine special-case overlap but excludes general rooted forests. residual_risks: Independence-based probabilistic formulations for continuous order-preserving rooted-tree labelings may be published under terminology not captured by the bounded searches.
The connection with known transfer maps makes portions of the proof short; historical priority requires an independent comprehensive literature review.

Special-case formulas for complete multipartite stable-set polytopes already cover chains, antichains, and rooted stars; this theorem claims all rooted forests and their exact sign trichotomy, not priority on those special cases.

value.rationale: An exact distributional factorization yields every polynomial interior moment, exact independent sampling, and efficient rational calculation for all finite rooted forests. The strict covariance-sign trichotomy recovers the full comparability relation and connected-component membership from geometric covariance data without reconstructing the orientation. This is a structural invariant of a natural infinite family, not a finite tabulation or routine hook-length restatement.
